# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Panel ürünü (yp_products) ↔ mağaza/pazaryeri ürünü (shop_products) köprüsü.

Tek kaynak paneldeki üründür. Panelde kaydedilen ürün aynı kimlikle mağazaya yazılır; böylece
/magaza, ürün sayfası, arama ve pazaryeri gönderimi (shop_sync) aynı ürünü görür.
Mağazada ya da pazaryerinde satış olunca düşen stok panele geri yazılır (geri()).
"""
import re

import urun

_TAG = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")


def _kisa(p):
    s = (p.get("short") or (p.get("seo") or {}).get("desc") or "").strip()
    if not s:
        s = " ".join(_TAG.sub(" ", p.get("desc") or "").split())[:200]
    return s[:240]


def belge(p):
    """yp ürününden mağaza belgesi (yalnız $set edilecek alanlar)."""
    price = urun._num(p.get("price"))
    sale = urun._num(p.get("sale_price"))
    on_sale = 0 < sale < price
    seo = p.get("seo") or {}
    ship = p.get("ship") or {}
    kanallar = {"site": {"enabled": bool((p.get("channels") or {}).get("site", True))}}
    for k, on in (p.get("channels") or {}).items():
        if k == "site" or k not in urun.CHANNELS:
            continue
        _liste, satis = urun.kanal_fiyat(p, k)
        kanallar[k] = {"enabled": bool(on), "price": satis if satis != (sale if on_sale else price) else 0.0, "buffer": 0}
    canli = p.get("status") != "draft" and kanallar["site"]["enabled"]
    taban = sale if on_sale else price
    varyant = []
    for v in (p.get("variants") or []):
        vp, vs = urun._num(v.get("price")), urun._num(v.get("sale_price"))
        if vp or vs:
            liste = vp or price
            etkin = vs if (vs and vs < liste) else liste
        else:
            liste, etkin = price, taban
        varyant.append({"id": v["id"], "opts": dict(v.get("opts") or {}), "label": " / ".join((v.get("opts") or {}).values()),
                        "sku": v.get("sku") or "", "barcode": v.get("barcode") or "", "stock": urun._int(v.get("stock")),
                        "price": etkin, "old_price": liste if etkin < liste else 0.0,
                        "image": v.get("image") or "", "active": v.get("active", True)})
    return {
        "variants": varyant, "var_axes": list(p.get("var_axes") or []),
        "name": p["name"], "slug": p.get("slug") or p["id"], "brand": p.get("brand") or "", "model": p.get("model") or "",
        "category": p.get("cat") or "", "categories": p.get("cats") or ([p["cat"]] if p.get("cat") else []),
        "price": sale if on_sale else price, "old_price": price if on_sale else 0.0,
        "stock": urun._int(p.get("stock")), "track_stock": p.get("track_stock", True) and not p.get("backorder"),
        "short": _kisa(p), "description": p.get("desc") or "",
        "specs": [{"k": x.get("k"), "v": x.get("v")} for x in (p.get("specs") or [])],
        "images": list(p.get("images") or []), "sku": p.get("sku") or "", "barcode": p.get("barcode") or "",
        "gtin": p.get("gtin") or "", "badge": p.get("badge") or "", "featured": bool(p.get("featured")),
        "active": canli, "kdv": urun._int(p.get("vat"), 20), "cost": urun._num(p.get("cost")),
        "desi": urun._num(p.get("desi")), "weight": urun._num(p.get("weight")),
        "delivery_days": urun._int(ship.get("gun"), 2), "free_ship": bool(ship.get("ucretsiz")),
        "warranty_months": 0, "unit": p.get("unit") or "Adet", "supplier": p.get("supplier") or "",
        "tags": list(p.get("tags") or []), "seo_title": seo.get("title") or "", "seo_desc": (seo.get("desc") or "")[:170],
        "seo_keywords": seo.get("keywords") or "", "canonical": seo.get("canonical") or "", "noindex": bool(seo.get("noindex")),
        "img_alt": seo.get("alt") or "", "video": p.get("video") or "", "related": list(p.get("related") or []), "personalization": list(p.get("personalization") or []),
        "min_qty": urun._int(p.get("min_qty"), 1), "max_qty": urun._int(p.get("max_qty")),
        "channels": kanallar, "src": {"panel": True}, "updated_at": p.get("updated_at") or urun._now(),
    }


async def ayna(db, pid):
    """Panel ürününü mağazaya yaz (yoksa oluşturur, silinmişse mağazadan da kaldırır)."""
    p = await db.yp_products.find_one({"id": pid}, {"_id": 0})
    if not p:
        await db.shop_products.delete_one({"id": pid, "src.panel": True})
        return
    doc = belge(p)
    ids = [i for i in (p.get("cat_ids") or []) if i]
    if ids:
        doc["category_id"], doc["category_ids"] = ids[0], ids
    await db.shop_products.update_one({"id": pid}, {"$set": doc,
                                                   "$setOnInsert": {"id": pid, "sold": 0, "sort": 100, "created_at": p.get("created_at") or urun._now()}},
                                      upsert=True)
    try:
        import shop
        await shop.stock_changed(db, [pid])                   # açık pazaryerlerine stok/fiyat güncellemesi kuyruğa
    except Exception:                                          # noqa: BLE001
        pass


async def ayna_hepsi(db):
    n = 0
    async for p in db.yp_products.find({}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1}):
        await ayna(db, p["id"])
        n += 1
    return n


async def geri(db, ids):
    """Mağaza/pazaryeri satışında düşen (ya da iadede artan) stoğu panel ürününe yaz."""
    for pid in set(ids or []):
        d = await db.shop_products.find_one({"id": pid, "src.panel": True}, {"_id": 0, "stock": 1, "variants": 1})
        if d is not None:
            up = {"stock": urun._int(d.get("stock")), "updated_at": urun._now()}
            if d.get("variants"):                  # varyantlı ürün: her seçeneğin stoğunu panele yaz, toplamı yeniden hesapla
                yp = await db.yp_products.find_one({"id": pid}, {"_id": 0, "variants": 1})
                st = {v["id"]: urun._int(v.get("stock")) for v in d["variants"]}
                vs = [dict(v, stock=st.get(v["id"], urun._int(v.get("stock")))) for v in (yp or {}).get("variants", [])]
                if vs:
                    up["variants"] = vs
                    up["stock"] = sum(v["stock"] for v in vs if v.get("active", True))
            await db.yp_products.update_one({"id": pid}, {"$set": up})

def catalog(sector="", modules=(), allow=None):
    """Sektöre ve açık modüllere göre bölüm listesi. allow=None → hepsi."""
    mods = set(modules or ())
    out = []
    for b in BLOCKS:
        if allow is not None and b["id"] not in allow:
            continue
        if b["sectors"] != ["*"] and sector and sector not in b["sectors"] and not ("shop" in mods and ("shop" in (b["needs"] or []) or b["cat"] == "eticaret")):
            continue
        if b["needs"] and not set(b["needs"]) <= mods:
            continue
        out.append({k: b[k] for k in ("id", "cat", "name", "desc", "wire", "tags", "manage", "resp")})
    return out


def counts(rows):

def fields_of(bid):
    b = BY_ID.get(bid)
    return list(b["fields"]) if b else []


def defaults(bid):
    """Bölüm eklenince kullanılacak başlangıç ayarları."""
    out = {}
    for f in fields_of(bid):
        if "d" in f:
            out[f["k"]] = f["d"]
    return out


_SAFE = re.compile(r"[^0-9a-zA-Z_\-]")


def new_instance(bid):
    """Sayfaya eklenen bölümün kaydı: kendi kimliği, ayarları ve mobil ayarları."""
    if bid not in BY_ID:
        return None
    return {"iid": uuid.uuid4().hex[:10], "bid": bid, "on": True,
            "set": defaults(bid), "set_m": {}, "badges": []}


def sanitize(bid, data, mobile=False):
    """Gelen ayarları alan tanımına göre süz; tanımsız alan kaydedilmez."""
    out = {}
    for f in fields_of(bid):
        if mobile and not f.get("m") and f["t"] not in ("sel", "sw", "slider", "num"):
            continue                                   # telefona ayrı tutulmayan alan set_m'ye yazılmaz
        k = f["k"]
        if k not in data:
            continue
        v = data[k]
        t = f["t"]
        if t == "sw":
            out[k] = bool(v)
        elif t in ("num", "slider"):
            try:
                n = float(v)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            if "min" in f:
                n = max(n, f["min"])
            if "max" in f:
                n = min(n, f["max"])
            out[k] = int(n) if n == int(n) else n
        elif t == "sel":
            opt = [str(o) for o in (f.get("opt") or [])]
            if not opt or str(v) in opt:
                out[k] = str(v)[:120]
        elif t == "color":
            if re.fullmatch(r"#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}", str(v)):
                out[k] = str(v)
        elif t in ("imgs", "urun", "rozet"):
            if isinstance(v, list):
                out[k] = [str(x)[:300] for x in v[:60]]
        elif t == "area":
            out[k] = str(v)[:4000]
        else:
            out[k] = str(v)[:300]
    return out

async def firma_modulleri(db):
    """(modüller, sektör, e-ticaret açık mı). Modüller: sahibin seçimi ya da sektör paketi.
    E-ticaret açıksa (paket 'shop' içeriyor ya da sahip firmaya 'E-ticaret' modülünü açtı)
    ürün, sipariş, kampanya, iade, pazaryeri, kargo, e-fatura ve üyelik birlikte gelir."""
    d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "yp_pack"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
    sec = d.get("sector")
    if not sec:
        s = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "sector"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        sec = s.get("key") or ""
    mods = d.get("modules")
    if mods is None:
        mods = list((pack(sec) or {}).get("modules") or [])
    acik = "shop" in mods
    if not acik:
        try:
            import tenant
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": tenant.current()}, {"_id": 0, "modules": 1}) if tenant.current() else None
            acik = "eticaret" in ((f or {}).get("modules") or [])
        except Exception:                                          # noqa: BLE001
            acik = False
    if acik:
        mods = list(dict.fromkeys(list(mods) + _SHOP_MOD))
    return list(mods), sec, acik

def _now():
    return datetime.now(TR).replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _t(v, n):
    return " ".join(str(v or "").split())[:n]


def mask(v):
    """Gizli değeri panele güvenle gösterilecek hâle getir."""
    v = str(v or "")
    if not v:
        return ""
    return "••••" + v[-4:] if len(v) > 4 else "••••"


def check(pid, keys, mode="test"):
    """Entegrasyon denemesi: eksik ve biçimsiz alanı söyle.

    Ağ erişimi olmadan da anlamlı bir deneme yapılır — alanların varlığı ve biçimi
    burada tutulur; gerçek çağrı canlıda `probe` ile yapılır. Böylece müşteri yanlış
    alana yapıştırdığı anahtarı dakikalar sonra sipariş kaybederek değil, hemen görür.
    """
    p = BY_ID.get(pid)
    if not p:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Entegrasyon bulunamadı")
    eksik = [f["label"] for f in p["fields"] if f["required"] and not _t(keys.get(f["key"]), 400)]
    if eksik:
        return False, "Şu alanlar boş: %s" % ", ".join(eksik)
    v = lambda k: _t(keys.get(k), 400)                             # noqa: E731
    if pid == "gtm" and not re.match(r"^GTM-[A-Z0-9]{4,10}$", v("id").upper()):
        return False, "Kapsayıcı kimliği GTM- ile başlamalı (örnek: GTM-ABC1234)"
    if pid == "ga4" and not re.match(r"^G-[A-Z0-9]{4,}$", v("id").upper()):
        return False, "Ölçüm kimliği G- ile başlamalı (örnek: G-ABC123DEF4)"
    if pid == "google_ads" and not re.match(r"^AW-\d{6,}$", v("id").upper()):
        return False, "Dönüşüm kimliği AW- ile başlamalı (örnek: AW-123456789)"
    if pid in ("meta_pixel", "tiktok_pixel") and not v("id").isdigit():
        return False, "Piksel kimliği yalnız rakamlardan oluşur"
    if pid == "havale":
        iban = v("iban").replace(" ", "").upper()
        if not re.match(r"^TR\d{24}$", iban):
            return False, "IBAN 'TR' ile başlamalı ve 26 karakter olmalı"
    if pid in ("gib_earsiv", "uyumsoft", "izibiz", "nes", "edm", "qnb_efinans"):
        vkn = v("vkn")
        if not (vkn.isdigit() and len(vkn) in (10, 11)):
            return False, "VKN 10, TCKN 11 haneli olmalı"
    if pid == "smtp":
        if not re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", v("from")):
            return False, "Gönderen adresi geçerli bir e-posta olmalı"
        if v("port") not in ("25", "465", "587", "2525"):
            return False, "Kapı numarası genelde 587 veya 465 olur"
    if p["group"] == "erp" and not v("url").startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        return False, "Sunucu adresi http:// veya https:// ile başlamalı"
    if pid == "netgsm" and len(v("header")) > 11:
        return False, "Mesaj başlığı en fazla 11 karakter olabilir"
    if mode == "canli" and p["group"] == "pos":
        for k in ("api_key", "api_secret", "pass"):
            if "test" in v(k).lower() or "sandbox" in v(k).lower():
                return False, "Canlı moda geçmeden önce test anahtarlarını değiştirin"
    return True, ""


def view(p, row, allowed):
    """Panelde görünecek hâli: anahtarlar maskeli, durum ve son hata açık."""
    row = row or {}
    keys = row.get("keys") or {}
    on = bool(row.get("on")) and bool(row.get("ok"))
    return {"id": p["id"], "group": p["group"], "name": p["name"], "desc": p["desc"], "hint": p["hint"],
            "can_test": p["can_test"], "allowed": allowed,
            "fields": [dict(f, value=(mask(keys.get(f["key"])) if f["secret"] else _t(keys.get(f["key"]), 400)),
                            filled=bool(_t(keys.get(f["key"]), 400))) for f in p["fields"]],
            "on": bool(row.get("on")), "ok": bool(row.get("ok")), "state": "bagli" if on else
            ("hata" if row.get("err") else ("kurulum" if row.get("keys") else "yok")),
            "mode": row.get("mode") or "test", "err": row.get("err") or "",
            "last_ok": row.get("last_ok") or "", "at": row.get("at") or ""}


def register(api_router, db, deps):
    adm = deps["require_admin"]
    probe = deps.get("probe")                                      # canlıda gerçek çağrıyı yapan yardımcı

    async def allow_list():
        """Sektör paketi + sahibin izni. None ise paketteki hepsi açık."""
        d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "yp_pack"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        sec = d.get("sector")
        if not sec:
            s = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "sector"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
            sec = s.get("key") or ""
        try:
            import blocks
            pack = list((blocks.pack(sec) or {}).get("integrations") or [])
        except Exception:                                          # noqa: BLE001
            pack = []
        izin = d.get("integrations_allowed")
        try:
            _m, _s, eshop = await blocks.firma_modulleri(db)
        except Exception:                                          # noqa: BLE001
            eshop = False
        if eshop:                                                  # e-ticaret açık: ödeme, pazaryeri, kargo, e-fatura, ERP hepsi gelir
            pack = list(dict.fromkeys(pack + blocks.SHOP_INT))
        if izin is None:                                           # sahip seçim yapmadıysa paketin kendi listesi
            return (set(pack) & set(BY_ID)) if pack else set(BY_ID)
        return set(izin) & set(BY_ID)                              # sahip seçtiyse söz onundur

    async def row_of(pid):
        return await db.yp_integrations.find_one({"id": pid}, {"_id": 0})

    async def log(pid, ev, note=""):
        await db.yp_int_log.insert_one({"id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], "int": pid, "event": ev,
                                        "note": _t(note, 300), "at": _now()})

    @api_router.get("/yp/integrations")
    async def listele(request: Request, group: str = "", _: dict = Depends(adm)):
        izin = await allow_list()
        rows = {r["id"]: r for r in await db.yp_integrations.find({}, {"_id": 0}).to_list(400)}
        items = [view(p, rows.get(p["id"]), p["id"] in izin) for p in CATALOG if p["id"] in izin]
        for i in items:
            if i["id"] == "yemeksepeti":                          # müşteri bu adresi Yemeksepeti'ye verir
                try:
                    import tenant
                    f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": tenant.current()}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1}) or {}
                    key = _t(((rows.get("yemeksepeti") or {}).get("keys") or {}).get("webhook_key"), 60) or "<bildirim anahtarınız>"
                    if f.get("id"):
                        i["hint"] = "Yemeksepeti'ne vereceğiniz bildirim adresi: %s/api/public/%s~yemek/yemeksepeti?k=%s" % (str(request.base_url).rstrip("/").replace("http://", "https://") if "testserver" not in str(request.base_url) and "localhost" not in str(request.base_url) else str(request.base_url).rstrip("/"), f["id"], key)
                except Exception:                                  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
        if group:
            items = [i for i in items if i["group"] == group]
        groups = [{"id": g, "name": n, "desc": d,
                   "n": len([i for i in items if i["group"] == g]),
                   "bagli": len([i for i in items if i["group"] == g and i["state"] == "bagli"]),
                   "hata": len([i for i in items if i["group"] == g and i["state"] == "hata"])}
                  for g, n, d in GROUPS]
        return {"items": items, "groups": [g for g in groups if g["n"]],
                "counts": {"hepsi": len(items),
                           "bagli": len([i for i in items if i["state"] == "bagli"]),
                           "hata": len([i for i in items if i["state"] == "hata"]),
                           "yok": len([i for i in items if i["state"] == "yok"])}}

    async def nerede(p):
        """Bu entegrasyon panelde nerede çalışıyor? Kapatmanın neyi durduracağını göster."""
        out = []
        if p["group"] in ("sms", "diger") and p["id"] != "canli_destek":
            try:
                import bildirim
                import blocks
                d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "yp_pack"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
                mods = d.get("modules")
                if mods is None:
                    mods = list((blocks.pack(d.get("sector") or "") or {}).get("modules") or [])
                mods = set(mods or [])
                rows = {r["id"]: r for r in await db.yp_notify.find({}, {"_id": 0}).to_list(200)}
                kanal = "whatsapp" if p["id"] == "whatsapp" else ("eposta" if p["id"] == "smtp" else "sms")
                for e in bildirim.EVENTS:
                    if e["module"] and e["module"] not in mods:    # firmanın paketinde olmayan olay gösterilmez
                        continue
                    r = rows.get(e["id"]) or {}
                    ks = r.get("channels") if r.get("channels") is not None else e["channels"]
                    if kanal in (ks or []) and r.get("on", bool(ks)):
                        out.append({"name": e["name"], "desc": e["desc"], "on": True})
            except Exception:                                      # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        if p["group"] == "pos":
            out.append({"name": "Sitede ödeme", "desc": "Müşteri kartla öderken", "on": True})
        if p["group"] == "kargo":
            out += [{"name": "Gönderi oluşturma", "desc": "Sipariş kargoya verilince", "on": True},
                    {"name": "Kargo fişi", "desc": "Takip numarası ve barkod", "on": True}]
        if p["group"] == "efatura":
            out.append({"name": "Fatura kesme", "desc": "Sipariş teslim edilince", "on": True})
        if p["group"] == "pazaryeri":
            out += [{"name": "Stok senkronu", "desc": "Satış olunca diğer kanallara bildirilir", "on": True},
                    {"name": "Sipariş aktarımı", "desc": "Pazaryeri siparişleri panele düşer", "on": True}]
        return out[:12]

    @api_router.get("/yp/integrations/{pid}")
    async def tek(pid: str, _: dict = Depends(adm)):
        p = BY_ID.get(_t(pid, 40))
        if not p:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Entegrasyon bulunamadı")
        izin = await allow_list()
        if p["id"] not in izin:
            raise HTTPException(403, "Bu entegrasyon paketinizde yok")
        return {"item": view(p, await row_of(p["id"]), True), "uses": await nerede(p)}

    @api_router.put("/yp/integrations/{pid}")
    async def kaydet(pid: str, payload: dict, _: dict = Depends(adm)):
        """Anahtarları kaydet. Boş gönderilen gizli alan eskisini korur."""
        p = BY_ID.get(_t(pid, 40))
        if not p:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Entegrasyon bulunamadı")
        if p["id"] not in await allow_list():
            raise HTTPException(403, "Bu entegrasyon paketinizde yok")
        old = await row_of(p["id"]) or {}
        keys = dict(old.get("keys") or {})
        gelen = payload.get("keys") or {}
        for f in p["fields"]:
            if f["key"] not in gelen:
                continue
            yeni = _t(gelen[f["key"]], 400)
            if f["secret"] and (not yeni or yeni.startswith("••••")):
                continue                                           # maskeli değer geri geldi: dokunma
            keys[f["key"]] = yeni
        mode = _t(payload.get("mode"), 10) or old.get("mode") or "test"
        if mode not in MODES:
            raise HTTPException(422, "Çalışma modu test veya canlı olmalı")
        ok, err = check(p["id"], keys, mode)
        on = bool(payload.get("on", old.get("on", False)))
        if ok and not old.get("ok"):
            on = True                                              # ilk başarılı bağlantı: kendiliğinden etkin (sonradan bilerek kapatılırsa kapalı kalır)
        row = {"id": p["id"], "group": p["group"], "keys": keys, "mode": mode, "on": on,
               "ok": ok, "err": "" if ok else err, "at": _now(),
               "last_ok": _now() if ok else (old.get("last_ok") or "")}
        await db.yp_integrations.update_one({"id": p["id"]}, {"$set": row}, upsert=True)
        await log(p["id"], "kaydedildi" if ok else "hata", err)
        if ok and on and not old.get("on"):                        # açıldığı andan itibaren gelen siparişler kaçmasın
            try:
                import markets_hub
                await markets_hub.baslangic(db, p["id"])
            except Exception:                                      # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        return {"ok": ok, "err": err, "item": view(p, row, True)}

    @api_router.post("/yp/integrations/{pid}/test")
    async def dene(pid: str, _: dict = Depends(adm)):
        p = BY_ID.get(_t(pid, 40))
        if not p:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Entegrasyon bulunamadı")
        row = await row_of(p["id"])
        if not row or not (row.get("keys") or {}):
            raise HTTPException(422, "Önce bilgileri girip kaydedin")
        ok, err = check(p["id"], row.get("keys") or {}, row.get("mode") or "test")
        msg = ""
        if ok and probe:
            try:
                sonuc = await probe(p["id"], row)
                ok, err = sonuc[0], sonuc[1]
                msg = sonuc[2] if len(sonuc) > 2 else ""
            except Exception as e:                                 # noqa: BLE001
                ok, err, msg = False, "Bağlantı kurulamadı: %s" % str(e)[:160], ""
        await db.yp_integrations.update_one({"id": p["id"]}, {"$set": {
            "ok": ok, "err": "" if ok else err, "at": _now(),
            "last_ok": _now() if ok else (row.get("last_ok") or "")}})
        await log(p["id"], "deneme başarılı" if ok else "deneme hatası", err or msg)
        return {"ok": ok, "err": err, "msg": (msg or "Bağlantı çalışıyor") if ok else err}

    @api_router.delete("/yp/integrations/{pid}")
    async def kaldir(pid: str, _: dict = Depends(adm)):
        p = BY_ID.get(_t(pid, 40))
        if not p:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Entegrasyon bulunamadı")
        await db.yp_integrations.delete_one({"id": p["id"]})
        await log(p["id"], "bağlantı kaldırıldı")
        return {"ok": True}

    @api_router.get("/yp/integrations/log/son")
    async def kayit(_: dict = Depends(adm)):
        rows = await db.yp_int_log.find({}, {"_id": 0}).to_list(400)
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("at") or "", reverse=True)
        for r in rows:
            r["name"] = (BY_ID.get(r.get("int")) or {}).get("name", r.get("int"))
        return {"items": rows[:80]}

    return api_router

def social_links(conf: dict) -> dict:
    """Panelde girilen sosyal hesapları güvenli, tam adrese çevirir (yalnızca http/https; boşlar atılır)."""
    out = {}
    for k, v in (conf or {}).items():
        v = str(v or "").strip()
        if not v or k not in CONFIG_FIELDS["social"]:
            continue
        if k == "whatsapp":
            d = re.sub(r"\D", "", v)
            d = ("90" + d[-10:]) if len(d) >= 10 else ""
            if d:
                out[k] = "https://wa.me/" + d
            continue
        if re.match(r"^https?://", v, re.I):
            out[k] = v[:300]
        elif k in _SOC_BASE and re.match(r"^@?[A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,60}$", v):
            out[k] = _SOC_BASE[k] % v.lstrip("@")
        elif re.match(r"^(www\.)?[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/\S*$", v, re.I):
            out[k] = "https://" + v[:290]
    return out

        d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "sp_modules"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}

        return {"flags": flags, "config": d.get("config") or {}}

    async def cfg(mid: str) -> dict:

    async def site_features() -> dict:
        d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "site_features"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        out = {**shopmod.FEATURES_DEFAULT, **d}
        out["quick_request"] = {**shopmod.FEATURES_DEFAULT["quick_request"], **(d.get("quick_request") or {})}

        d = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "shop_settings"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}

    def masked(config: dict) -> dict:
        out = {}
        for mid, vals in (config or {}).items():
            fields = CONFIG_FIELDS.get(mid, {})
            out[mid] = {k: (("•" * 6 + str(v)[-3:]) if fields.get(k, ("", False))[1] and v else v) for k, v in (vals or {}).items()}
        return out

    async def put_modules(p: ModulesIn, _: dict = adm):
        cur = await db.app_settings.find_one({"_id": "sp_modules"}, {"_id": 0}) or {"flags": {}, "config": {}}
        flags, conf = cur.get("flags") or {}, cur.get("config") or {}
        for k, v in (p.flags or {}).items():
            if k in MODULE_IDS:
                flags[k] = bool(v)
        for mid, vals in (p.config or {}).items():
            if mid not in CONFIG_FIELDS:
                continue
            tgt = conf.get(mid, {})
            for k, v in (vals or {}).items():
                if k not in CONFIG_FIELDS[mid]:
                    continue
                if CONFIG_FIELDS[mid][k][1] and isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("••"):
                    continue  # maskeli değer değişmedi
                tgt[k] = clean(v, 4000 if k == "rules" else 300)
            conf[mid] = tgt
        await db.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "sp_modules"}, {"$set": {"flags": flags, "config": conf, "updated_at": now_iso()}}, upsert=True)
        return await get_modules(_)

    @api_router.get("/admin/keywords")
    async def keywords(q: str, _: dict = adm):
        q = clean(q, 80)
        if len(q) < 2:
            return {"items": []}
        out, seen = [], set()
        for suffix in ["", " a", " b", " c", " d", " f", " k", " m", " s", " t", " fiyat", " servisi", " ankara"]:
            try:
                r = await asyncio.to_thread(lambda: requests.get("https://suggestqueries.google.com/complete/search", params={"client": "firefox", "hl": "tr", "gl": "tr", "q": q + suffix}, timeout=6))
                for it in r.json()[1]:
                    if it not in seen:
                        seen.add(it)
                        out.append(it)
            except Exception:
                continue
        if not out:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Google öneri servisine erişilemedi")
        return {"items": out[:80], "note": "Aylık arama hacmi için Google Ads Keyword Planner hesabı bağlanmalıdır; burada Google arama önerileri listelenir."}

    @api_router.post("/public/capi-track")
    async def capi_track(p: TrackIn, request: Request):
        d = await modules_doc()
        c = d["config"].get("fb_capi", {})
        if not (d["flags"]["fb_capi"] and c.get("pixel_id") and c.get("access_token")):
            return {"ok": True, "sent": False}
        sha = lambda x: hashlib.sha256(x.strip().lower().encode()).hexdigest() if x else None
        ph = re.sub(r"\D", "", p.phone or "")
        if len(ph) == 11 and ph.startswith("0"):
            ph = "9" + ph
        elif len(ph) == 10:
            ph = "90" + ph
        xf = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "").split(",")[0].strip() or (request.client.host if request.client else "")
        ud = {k: v for k, v in {"em": [sha(p.email)] if p.email else None, "ph": [sha(ph)] if ph else None, "client_ip_address": xf,
                                "client_user_agent": request.headers.get("user-agent", "")}.items() if v}
        ev = {"event_name": clean(p.event, 40) or "Lead", "event_time": int(time.time()), "action_source": "website", "event_source_url": clean(p.url, 300),
              "event_id": clean(p.event_id, 60) or uuid.uuid4().hex, "user_data": ud}
        if p.value:
            ev["custom_data"] = {"value": float(p.value), "currency": "TRY"}
        body = {"data": [ev]}
        if c.get("test_code"):
            body["test_event_code"] = c["test_code"]
        try:
            r = await asyncio.to_thread(lambda: requests.post(f"https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/{c['pixel_id']}/events", params={"access_token": c["access_token"]}, json=body, timeout=8))
            return {"ok": r.ok, "sent": r.ok}
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("capi: %s", e)
            return {"ok": False, "sent": False}

    @api_router.post("/shop/orders-create")
    async def admin_order_create(p: AdminOrderIn, _: dict = adm):
        if not p.items:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="En az bir ürün seçin")
        if not shopmod.valid_phone(p.phone):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Geçerli telefon girin")
        items, sub, done = [], 0.0, []
        for it in p.items:
            pr = await db.shop_products.find_one({"id": it.product_id}, {"_id": 0})
            if not pr:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Ürün bulunamadı")
            q = max(1, min(999, it.qty))
            if pr.get("variants"):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"“{pr['name']}” için seçenek (renk/beden) seçilmeli; mağaza sayfasından sipariş verin")
            r = await db.shop_products.update_one({"id": pr["id"], "$or": [{"track_stock": False}, {"stock": {"$gte": q}}]}, {"$inc": {"stock": -q, "sold": q}})
            if not r.modified_count:
                for d in done:
                    await db.shop_products.update_one({"id": d["product_id"], "track_stock": True}, {"$inc": {"stock": d["qty"], "sold": -d["qty"]}})
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"“{pr['name']}” için yeterli stok yok")
            line = round(float(pr.get("price", 0)) * q, 2)
            sub += line
            row = {"product_id": pr["id"], "name": pr["name"], "brand": pr.get("brand", ""), "model": pr.get("model", ""), "price": pr["price"], "qty": q,
                   "line_total": line, "image": (pr.get("images") or [""])[0]}
            items.append(row)
            done.append(row)
        await shopmod.stock_changed(db, [d["product_id"] for d in done])
        cfg_ = await shop_cfg()
        ship = 0.0 if (cfg_["free_shipping_over"] and sub >= cfg_["free_shipping_over"]) else float(cfg_["shipping_fee"] or 0)
        status = p.status if p.status in shopmod.ORDER_STATUSES else "odeme_bekliyor"
        n = await db.shop_orders.count_documents({})
        while True:
            n += 1
            no = f"{cfg_['order_prefix'] or 'SP'}-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%y%m')}-{n:04d}"
            if not await db.shop_orders.find_one({"order_no": no}, {"_id": 1}):
                break
        acc = await db.customer_accounts.find_one({"phone_key": shopmod.phone_key(p.phone)}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1})
        order = {"id": shopmod._id(), "order_no": no, "status": status,
                 "customer": {"name": clean(p.name, 120), "phone": clean(p.phone, 30), "email": clean(p.email, 120), "city": clean(p.city, 60),
                              "district": clean(p.district, 60), "address": clean(p.address, 400)},
                 "note": clean(p.note, 500), "items": items, "subtotal": round(sub, 2), "shipping": ship, "total": round(sub + ship, 2),
                 "account_id": (acc or {}).get("id", ""), "phone_key": shopmod.phone_key(p.phone), "payment": {}, "admin_note": "Panelden oluşturuldu",
                 "tracking_no": "", "carrier": "", "source": "panel", "history": [{"status": status, "at": now_iso()}], "created_at": now_iso(), "updated_at": now_iso()}
        await db.shop_orders.insert_one(dict(order))
        order.pop("_id", None)
        return order

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Pazaryeri ve yemek platformlarından çekilen siparişi müşteri panelinin Siparişler listesine (yp_orders) yazar.

Stok burada düşülmez: markets_hub.apply_market_order zaten tek havuzdan bir kez düşer.
Aynı sipariş ikinci kez gelirse yeni kayıt açılmaz, yalnızca durumu güncellenir.
"""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    TR = ZoneInfo("Europe/Istanbul")
except Exception:                                                  # noqa: BLE001
    TR = timezone(timedelta(hours=3))

ON = {"yemeksepeti": "YS", "trendyol_yemek": "TYY", "getir_yemek": "GY", "migros_yemek": "MY", "trendyol": "TY", "hepsiburada": "HB",
      "n11": "N11", "ciceksepeti": "CS", "pazarama": "PZ", "pttavm": "PTT", "site": "SP"}
DURUM = {"onaylandi": "onaylandi", "hazirlaniyor": "hazirlaniyor", "kargoda": "kargoda", "teslim_edildi": "teslim", "iptal": "iptal"}


def _now():
    return datetime.now(TR).replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


async def yaz(db, mk, n, mapped, comm=None):
    """n: markets_hub.normalize çıktısı. Döner: True = yeni kayıt açıldı."""
    st = DURUM.get(mapped, "yeni")
    cur = await db.yp_orders.find_one({"channel": mk, "market_no": n["key"]}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1, "status": 1})
    if cur:
        if cur.get("status") != st:
            await db.yp_orders.update_one({"id": cur["id"]}, {"$set": {"status": st}, "$push": {"timeline": {"at": _now(), "by": mk, "state": st, "note": "platformdan güncellendi"}}})
            await kasaya_isle(db, cur["id"])
        return False
    items = []
    for ln in n["lines"]:
        pid, cost, vat = "", 0, 20.0
        if ln.get("barcode"):
            p = await db.yp_products.find_one({"$or": [{"barcode": ln["barcode"]}, {"sku": ln["barcode"]}]}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1, "cost": 1, "vat": 1})
            pid = (p or {}).get("id", "")
            try:                                           # kâr hesabı için ürün kartındaki alış maliyeti ve KDV oranı
                cost = float((p or {}).get("cost") or 0)
                vat = float((p or {}).get("vat") or 20.0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                cost, vat = 0, 20.0
        items.append({"product": pid, "name": ln["name"], "sku": ln["barcode"], "qty": ln["quantity"], "price": ln["price"], "discount": 0, "cost": cost, "vat": vat})
    cu = n["customer"]
    cnt = await db.yp_orders.count_documents({})
    at = (n["created"].astimezone(TR).replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat(timespec="seconds") if n.get("created") else _now())
    o = {"id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], "no": ("%s-%s" % (ON.get(mk, mk[:3].upper()), n["key"]))[:30], "channel": mk, "at": at, "seq": cnt + 1, "status": st,
         "customer": {"name": cu.get("name") or "Platform müşterisi", "phone": "".join(c for c in cu.get("phone", "") if c.isdigit())[-11:], "email": cu.get("email", ""),
                      "city": cu.get("city", ""), "district": cu.get("district", ""), "address": cu.get("address", ""), "group": "", "tckn": "", "note": ""},
         "items": items, "subtotal": n["total"], "discount": 0, "camps": [], "coupon": "", "ship_fee": 0, "ship_cost": 0, "free_ship": False, "gifts": [],
         "total": n["total"], "payment": "pazaryeri", "paid": True, "market_no": n["key"],
         "cargo": {"firm": "", "code": "", "barcode": "", "label": ""}, "invoice": {"no": "", "uuid": "", "state": ""}, "note": "",
         "external": True, "timeline": [{"at": _now(), "by": mk, "state": st, "note": "platformdan alındı"}]}
    if comm is not None:
        o["comm"] = comm
    await db.yp_orders.insert_one(o)
    await kasaya_isle(db, o["id"])
    return True


KASA_YONT = {"nakit": "Nakit", "kart": "Kart", "havale": "Havale", "kapida_nakit": "Nakit", "kapida_kart": "Kart"}


async def kasaya_isle(db, oid):
    """Teslim edilen siparişin tahsilatı kasaya, komisyon ve kargo gideri çıkış olarak işlenir. Aynı sipariş bir kez."""
    o = await db.yp_orders.find_one({"id": oid}, {"_id": 0})
    if not o or o.get("status") != "teslim":
        return False
    if await db.yp_cash.find_one({"ref": oid, "kind": "siparis"}, {"_id": 1}):
        return False
    try:
        tot = float(o.get("total") or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        tot = 0
    if tot <= 0:
        return False
    at = _now()[:16]
    mt = KASA_YONT.get(o.get("payment"), "Havale")
    no = o.get("no", "")
    rows = [{"type": "in", "amount": round(tot, 2), "method": mt, "desc": "Sipariş %s tahsilat" % no}]
    try:
        kom = round(tot * float(o.get("comm") or 0) / 100.0, 2)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        kom = 0
    if kom > 0:
        rows.append({"type": "out", "amount": kom, "method": "Havale", "desc": "Sipariş %s pazaryeri komisyonu" % no})
    try:
        kg = round(float(o.get("ship_cost") or 0), 2)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        kg = 0
    if kg > 0:
        rows.append({"type": "out", "amount": kg, "method": "Havale", "desc": "Sipariş %s kargo gideri" % no})
    for r in rows:
        await db.yp_cash.insert_one({"id": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], "at": at, "kind": "siparis", "ref": oid, "ref_no": no, "staff_id": "", "by": "sistem", **r})
    return True

def register(api_router, db, deps):
    require_admin = deps["require_admin"]
    get_current_user = deps["get_current_user"]
    verify_password = deps["verify_password"]
    hash_password = deps["hash_password"]

    def need_main():
        if tenant.current():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Bu işlem yalnız ana yönetim içindir")

    async def audit(me, action, detail):
        try:
            import governance
            await governance.audit(db.main(), me, action, detail)
        except Exception:                                  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    async def derive_from_main():
        """ServisPlus'ın kendi PDF notundan şablon üretir: ServisPlus adı/telefonu/adresi yer tutuculara çevrilir."""
        g = await db.main().app_settings.find_one({"_id": "global"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        note = (g.get("default_pdf_note") or "").strip()
        if not note:
            return DEFAULT_PDF_NOTE
        for key, ph in (("company_address", "{adres}"), ("company_phone", "{telefon}"), ("company_name", "{firma_adi}")):
            v = (g.get(key) or "").strip()
            if len(v) >= 3:
                note = note.replace(v, ph)
        note = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(?:https?://)?(?:www\.|bayi\.)?servisplus\.net\.tr\S*", "", note)
        note = re.sub(r"(?<![\w.])servis\s*plus(?:\s+usta)?(?![\w.])", "{firma_adi}", note, flags=re.I)
        note = re.sub(r"0?\s?544[\s-]?444[\s-]?4[\s-]?004|0?850[\s\d]{7,10}", "{telefon}", note)
        return re.sub(r"[ \t]{2,}", " ", note).strip()

    async def template():
        d = await db.main().app_settings.find_one({"_id": "firm_defaults"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        return d.get("pdf_note") or await derive_from_main()

    def render(tpl, f):
        return (tpl.replace("{firma_adi}", f.get("name", "")).replace("{adres}", f.get("address", "") or "-")
                .replace("{telefon}", f.get("phone", "") or "-"))

    async def packages_get():
        d = await db.main().app_settings.find_one({"_id": "packages"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        items = d.get("items")
        if not items:
            return DEFAULT_PACKAGES
        out = {**items, **{k: v for k, v in DEFAULT_PACKAGES.items() if k == "kurumsal" and k not in items}}
        if "kurumsal" in out:                              # Kurumsal paket her zaman tüm modülleri içerir; ek modül yoktur
            out["kurumsal"] = {**out["kurumsal"], "modules": list(ALL_MODS)}
        return out

    def clean_modules(v):
        out = ["servis"] + [m for m in (v or []) if m in MODULES and m != "servis"]
        return list(dict.fromkeys(out))

    async def resolve_modules(package, modules):
        if package == "kurumsal":
            return list(ALL_MODS)
        if modules is not None:
            return clean_modules(modules)
        pk = (await packages_get()).get(package or "")
        if package and not pk:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Bilinmeyen paket")
        return clean_modules((pk or {}).get("modules") or ["servis"])

    @api_router.get("/admin/packages")

        need_main()
        return {"packages": await packages_get(), "modules": MODULES, "soon": SOON}

    @api_router.put("/admin/packages")
    async def packages_save(body: dict, me: dict = Depends(require_admin)):
        need_main()
        items = {}
        for k, v in (body.get("packages") or {}).items():
            if not re.match(r"^[a-z0-9_]{2,30}$", k):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Paket anahtarı geçersiz")
            feats = [" ".join(str(x).split())[:90] for x in (v.get("features") or []) if str(x).strip()][:12]
            items[k] = {"name": str(v.get("name") or k)[:40], "price": float(v.get("price") or 0), "yearly": float(v.get("yearly") or 0),
                        "tagline": " ".join(str(v.get("tagline") or "").split())[:140], "features": feats,
                        "modules": list(ALL_MODS) if k == "kurumsal" else clean_modules(v.get("modules"))}
        if not items:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="En az bir paket olmalı")
        await db.main().app_settings.update_one({"_id": "packages"}, {"$set": {"items": items}}, upsert=True)
        return {"packages": items}

    @api_router.get("/public/packages")
    async def packages_public():
        """Sitedeki fiyat sayfası için: yönetimde düzenlenen ad, fiyat, açıklama ve madde listesi."""
        out = []
        for k, v in (await packages_get()).items():
            d = DEFAULT_PACKAGES.get(k, {})
            price = float(v.get("price") or 0)
            out.append({"id": k, "name": v.get("name") or k, "price": price,
                        "yearly": float(v.get("yearly") or 0) or (price * 10 if price else 0),
                        "tagline": v.get("tagline") or d.get("tagline") or "", "features": v.get("features") or d.get("features") or [],
                        "modules": len(v.get("modules") or [])})
        return {"packages": out}

    _MOD = {}

    async def gate(dbname, path):
        """Firmanın paketinde olmayan modülün API'sini kapatır. Modül listesi 30 sn önbellekte."""
        import time as _t
        e = _MOD.get(dbname)
        if not e or _t.monotonic() - e[0] > 30:
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": dbname}, {"_id": 0, "modules": 1, "package": 1})
            e = (_t.monotonic(), list(ALL_MODS) if (f or {}).get("package") == "kurumsal" else (f or {}).get("modules"))
            _MOD[dbname] = e
        mods = e[1]
        if mods is None:
            return None                                   # modül tanımı olmayan eski firma: kısıt yok
        seg = path[5:] if path.startswith("/api/") else ""
        eff = set(mods) | ({"randevu"} if "pazarlama" in mods else set()) | ({"magaza", "site"} if "eticaret" in mods else set())   # e-ticaret mağaza uçlarını da açar      # pazarlama paketi online randevuyu da kapsar (eski paketler bozulmaz)
        bk = seg.startswith(("growth/bookings", "growth/settings"))
        for m, pre in MODULE_PREFIX.items():
            if m == "pazarlama" and bk and "randevu" in eff:                    # yalnız Online randevu olan firma randevu ayarlarını ve kayıtlarını yönetebilir
                continue
            if m not in eff and any(seg == p or seg.startswith(p + "/") for p in pre):
                return f"“{MODULES[m]}” bu paketinizde yok. Paket yükseltmek için bizimle iletişime geçin."
        return None

    global GATE
    GATE = gate

    @api_router.get("/firm/package")
    async def firm_package(request: Request, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
        f = await my_firm(request)
        mods = list(ALL_MODS) if f.get("package") == "kurumsal" else (f.get("modules") or list(MODULES))
        exp = f.get("expires_at") or ""
        days = None
        if exp:
            try:
                days = int(-(-((datetime.fromisoformat(exp) - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).total_seconds()) // 86400))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                days = None
        try:
            import sektor_dil
            sl, sh = sektor_dil.module_view(f.get("sector") or "")
        except Exception:                                  # noqa: BLE001
            sl, sh = {}, []
        labels = {m: sl.get(m, MODULES[m]) for m in MODULES if m not in sh}
        mods = list(dict.fromkeys(list(mods) + (["randevu"] if "pazarlama" in mods else [])))
        return {"package": f.get("package", ""), "modules": [m for m in mods if m not in sh], "labels": labels, "locked": [m for m in MODULES if m not in mods and m not in sh], "soon": SOON,
                "expires_at": exp, "days_left": days, "unlimited": not exp, "since": f.get("created_at", "")}

    async def push_settings(f):
        fdb = db.firm(f["db"])
        await fdb.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "global"}, {"$set": {
            "company_name": f.get("name", ""), "company_phone": f.get("phone", ""), "company_address": f.get("address", ""),
            "company_tax_no": f.get("tax_no", ""), "company_tax_office": f.get("tax_office", ""),
            "default_pdf_note": render(f.get("pdf_note") or await template(), f),
            "is_firm": True, "has_logo": bool(f.get("logo")),
            # firma kendi verisinin sahibi: gece gizleme ve 7 gün sınırı uygulanmaz
            "tech_visibility": {"enabled": False, "hide_from": "22:00", "show_from": "07:00", "done_days": 36500}}}, upsert=True)
        await fdb.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "firm_logo"}, {"$set": {"data": f.get("logo", "")}}, upsert=True)
        await fdb.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "firm"}, {"$set": {
            "firm_id": f["id"], "name": f.get("name", ""), "features": f.get("features") or {}}}, upsert=True)

    async def sync_shop(f, mods, prev):
        """Mağaza paketi açılınca site (Mağaza sayfaları) + panel (Ürünler/Siparişler) birlikte açılır; kapanınca ikisi de kapanır."""
        if mods is None:
            return
        fdb = db.firm(f["db"])
        await fdb.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "firm"}, {"$set": {"modules": list(mods)}}, upsert=True)
        on = "magaza" in mods or "eticaret" in mods
        was = prev is None or "magaza" in prev or "eticaret" in prev
        if (not on) or (on != was):
            await fdb.app_settings.update_one({"_id": "site_features"}, {"$set": {"shop_enabled": on}}, upsert=True)

    def feats(v):
        out = dict(DEFAULT_FEATURES)
        for k in DEFAULT_FEATURES:
            if isinstance(v, dict) and k in v:
                out[k] = bool(v[k])
        return out

    def clean_logo(v):
        v = (v or "").strip()
        if not v:
            return ""
        if not re.match(r"^data:image/(png|jpeg|jpg|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$", v) or len(v) > 1_200_000:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Logo PNG/JPG/WEBP olmalı ve 800 KB'ı geçmemeli")
        return v

    async def get_firm(fid):
        f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"id": fid}, {"_id": 0})
        if not f:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Firma bulunamadı")
        return f

    async def stats_randevu(fdb):
        """Randevuyla çalışan işlerde (kuaför, klinik...) sayılar servis kaydından değil randevu defterinden gelir."""
        by, cust, rev, rev_m, jobs_m, last = {}, set(), 0.0, 0.0, 0, ""
        ay = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=3))).date().isoformat()[:7]
        for b in await fdb.bookings.find({}, {"_id": 0}).to_list(200000):
            st = b.get("stage") or {"bekliyor": "talep", "onaylandi": "bekliyor", "tamamlandi": "tamamlandi"}.get(b.get("status"), "iptal")
            by[st] = by.get(st, 0) + 1
            if b.get("phone"):
                cust.add(b["phone"])
            last = max(last, str(b.get("created_at") or ""))
            for p in b.get("payments") or []:
                try:
                    a = float(p.get("amount") or 0)
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    a = 0.0
                rev += a
                if str(p.get("at") or "")[:7] == ay:
                    rev_m += a
            if st == "tamamlandi" and str(b.get("date") or "")[:7] == ay:
                jobs_m += 1
        done = by.get("tamamlandi", 0)
        return {"by_status": by, "open": by.get("bekliyor", 0) + by.get("talep", 0), "done": done, "total": sum(by.values()), "customers": len(cust),
                "last_activity": last, "revenue_total": round(rev, 2), "revenue_month": round(rev_m, 2), "jobs_month": jobs_m,
                "avg_ticket": round(rev / done, 2) if done else 0, "cancelled": by.get("iptal", 0) + by.get("gelmedi", 0)}

        by = {}
        async for r in fdb.service_jobs.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$status", "n": {"$sum": 1}}}]):
            by[r["_id"] or "yeni"] = r["n"]
        last = await fdb.service_jobs.find({}, {"_id": 0, "updated_at": 1}).sort("updated_at", -1).limit(1).to_list(1)
        open_n = sum(n for s, n in by.items() if s in ("yeni", "atandi", "yolda", "basladi"))
        done_n = sum(n for s, n in by.items() if s in ("tamamlandi", "faturalandi"))
        rp = await build_report(fdb, 2)
        return {"by_status": by, "open": open_n, "done": done_n, "total": sum(by.values()),
                "customers": await fdb.customers.count_documents({}),

                "revenue_total": rp["total"]["revenue"], "revenue_month": rp["current"]["revenue"], "jobs_month": rp["current"]["jobs"],
                "avg_ticket": rp["avg_ticket"], "cancelled": by.get("iptal", 0)}

    @api_router.post("/admin/firms/sil")
    async def firms_delete(body: dict, me: dict = Depends(require_admin)):
        """Firmaları tek tek ya da toplu siler. Varsayılan: giriş ve alan adı kapanır, veri saklanır. kalici=true: firma veritabanı da silinir."""
        need_main()
        ids = [str(x) for x in (body.get("ids") or []) if x][:300]
        kalici = bool(body.get("kalici"))
        if not ids:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Silinecek firma seçin")
        n, adlar = 0, []
        for fid in ids:
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"id": fid, "status": {"$ne": "silindi"}}, {"_id": 0})
            if not f:
                continue
            await db.main().firm_domains.delete_many({"firm_id": fid})
            await db.main().firm_users.delete_many({"firm_id": fid})
            if kalici:
                try:
                    await db._client.drop_database(f["db"])
                except Exception:                          # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
                await db.main().firms.delete_one({"id": fid})
            else:
                await db.main().firms.update_one({"id": fid}, {"$set": {"status": "silindi", "deleted_at": _now()}})

    @api_router.post("/admin/bulk")
    async def bulk_action(body: dict, me: dict = Depends(require_admin)):
        """Birden çok firmaya aynı anda: paket, modül aç/kapat, süre uzat, askıya al / aç."""
        need_main()
        ids = [str(x) for x in (body.get("ids") or [])][:500]
        act, val = body.get("action"), body.get("value")
        if not ids:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Firma seçin")
        if act not in ("package", "module_on", "module_off", "extend", "status"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz işlem")
        if act in ("module_on", "module_off") and val not in MODULES:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz modül")
        if act == "status" and val not in ("aktif", "askida"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz durum")
        try:
            days = int(val) if act == "extend" else 0
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Gün sayı olmalı")
        if act == "extend" and not 0 < days <= 3650:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Gün 1-3650 arası olmalı")
        n, skipped, now = 0, 0, datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        for fid in ids:
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"id": fid}, {"_id": 0})
            if not f:
                skipped += 1
                continue
            upd, uset = {}, {}
            if act == "package":
                upd["package"] = str(val)
                upd["modules"] = await resolve_modules(str(val), None)
            elif act in ("module_on", "module_off"):
                m = set(f.get("modules") or [])
                (m.add if act == "module_on" else m.discard)(val)
                m.add("servis")
                upd["modules"] = clean_modules(list(m))
            elif act == "extend":
                cur = f.get("expires_at") or ""
                base = datetime.fromisoformat(cur) if cur and cur > now.isoformat() else now
                upd["expires_at"] = (base + timedelta(days=days)).isoformat()
                upd["status"] = "aktif"
                uset["is_active"] = True
            else:
                upd["status"] = val
                uset["is_active"] = val == "aktif"
                if val == "askida":
                    uset["tokens_valid_after"] = int(time.time())
            await db.main().firms.update_one({"id": fid}, {"$set": upd})
            if "modules" in upd:
                await sync_shop(f, upd["modules"], f.get("modules"))
            if uset:
                await db.firm(f["db"]).users.update_many({"firm_owner": True}, {"$set": uset})
            n += 1
        _ACC.clear()
        _MOD.clear()
        await audit(me, "TOPLU İŞLEM", f"{act}={val} · {n} firma")
        return {"ok": True, "updated": n, "skipped": skipped}

        """Firma jetonu geçerli mi: firma silinmemiş, süresi dolmamış, (alt kullanıcıysa) açık olmalı. 30 sn önbellek."""
        import time as _t
        k = (dbname, fu or "")
        e = _ACC.get(k)
        if e and _t.monotonic() - e[0] < 30:
            return e[1]
        f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": dbname}, {"_id": 0, "status": 1, "expires_at": 1, "id": 1})
        ok = bool(f) and f.get("status") not in ("silindi", "askida") and not expired(f)
        if ok and fu:
            ok = bool(await db.main().firm_users.find_one({"firm_id": f["id"], "email": fu, "active": {"$ne": False}}, {"_id": 1}))
        _ACC[k] = (_t.monotonic(), ok)
        return ok

            v = getattr(p, k)
            if v is None:
                continue
            v = v.strip()
            if k == "name" and len(v) < 2:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Firma adı yazın")

    async def build_report(fdb, months=12):
        months = max(1, min(int(months or 12), 36))
        rows = await fdb.service_jobs.find({}, {"_id": 0, "status": 1, "total_amount": 1, "labor_fee": 1, "parts_used": 1, "completed_at": 1,
                                                "updated_at": 1, "created_at": 1, "device_type": 1, "customer_name": 1}).to_list(100000)
        def num(x):
            try:
                return float(x or 0)
            except Exception:                              # noqa: BLE001
                return 0.0
        now = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=3)))
        keys = []
        y, m = now.year, now.month
        for _ in range(months):
            keys.append("%04d-%02d" % (y, m))
            m -= 1
            if m == 0:
                y, m = y - 1, 12
        keys.reverse()
        by = {k: {"month": k, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0, "parts": 0.0, "labor": 0.0} for k in keys}
        dev, cust = {}, {}
        tot = {"revenue": 0.0, "parts": 0.0, "labor": 0.0, "jobs": 0}
        openn = cancelled = 0
        for j in rows:
            st = j.get("status")
            if st in ("yeni", "atandi", "yolda", "basladi"):
                openn += 1
                continue
            if st == "iptal":
                cancelled += 1
                continue
            if st not in ("tamamlandi", "faturalandi"):
                continue
            parts = sum(num(p.get("qty", 1)) * num(p.get("unit_price")) for p in (j.get("parts_used") or []))
            labor = num(j.get("labor_fee"))
            rev = num(j.get("total_amount")) or (parts + labor)
            tot["revenue"] += rev; tot["parts"] += parts; tot["labor"] += labor; tot["jobs"] += 1
            k = (j.get("completed_at") or j.get("updated_at") or j.get("created_at") or "")[:7]
            if k in by:
                b = by[k]; b["jobs"] += 1; b["revenue"] += rev; b["parts"] += parts; b["labor"] += labor
            d = (j.get("device_type") or "Diğer").strip().title() or "Diğer"
            e = dev.setdefault(d, {"name": d, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0}); e["jobs"] += 1; e["revenue"] += rev
            c = (j.get("customer_name") or "—").strip()
            e2 = cust.setdefault(c, {"name": c, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0}); e2["jobs"] += 1; e2["revenue"] += rev
        ml = list(by.values())
        for b in ml:
            for k2 in ("revenue", "parts", "labor"):
                b[k2] = round(b[k2], 2)
        cur = ml[-1]; prev = ml[-2] if len(ml) > 1 else {"revenue": 0, "jobs": 0}
        chg = round((cur["revenue"] - prev["revenue"]) / prev["revenue"] * 100, 1) if prev["revenue"] else None
        best = max(ml, key=lambda b: b["revenue"]) if ml else None
        return {"months": ml, "current": cur, "previous": prev, "change_pct": chg,
                "total": {k2: (round(v, 2) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k2, v in tot.items()},
                "avg_ticket": round(tot["revenue"] / tot["jobs"], 2) if tot["jobs"] else 0,
                "open": openn, "cancelled": cancelled, "best_month": best if best and best["revenue"] else None,
                "devices": sorted([dict(v, revenue=round(v["revenue"], 2)) for v in dev.values()], key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:6],
                "customers": sorted([dict(v, revenue=round(v["revenue"], 2)) for v in cust.values()], key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:5]}

    def fonly():

    def _d(v, field="Tarih", required=False):
        v = (v or "").strip()[:10]
        if not v and not required:
            return ""
        try:
            datetime.strptime(v, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=field + " geçersiz (GG.AA.YYYY)")
        return v

    def _amt(v):
        try:
            x = round(float(v), 2)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Tutar geçersiz")
        if not (0 < x < 100000000):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Tutar geçersiz")
        return x

    def _today():
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    def _add_months(d, n):
        y, m, dd = [int(x) for x in d.split("-")]
        t = y * 12 + (m - 1) + int(n)
        y, m = divmod(t, 12)
        m += 1
        import calendar
        return "%04d-%02d-%02d" % (y, m, min(dd, calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]))

    return a, (b or a)

def labels(key):
    """Menü etiketi eşlemesi (eski 'terms' biçimi): özgün başlık -> sektöre uygun başlık."""
    r = ROWS.get(key)
    if not r:
        return {}
    ks, kp = _sp(r["kisi"])
    isg, ipl = _sp(r["is"])
    ab = _abl(ks)
    t = {
        "Servis Kayıtları": ipl, "Randevular": RDV.get(key, "Online Randevular"), "Garanti Talepleri": GAR.get(r["garanti"], r["garanti"] + " Talepleri"),
        "Teknisyenler": kp, "Ustalar": kp, "Yedek Parça": r["stok"], "Atölye (Cihaz Teslim)": r["yer"], "Günün İş Haritası": r["gun"], "Fiyat Teklifleri": r["teklif"],
        "Usta Puanlama": ks + " Puanlama", "Usta İş Geçmişi": ks + " Geçmişi", "Ustadan Para Aldım": ks + ab + " Tahsilat",
        "Ustaların Borç Durumu": ks + " Hesapları", "Geciken Usta Borçları": "Geciken " + ks + " Hesapları",
    }
    t.update(FAM_TERMS.get(FAMILY.get(key, ""), {}))
    return t


_VOW = "aeıioöuü"
_BACK = "aıou"


def _last_vowel(w):
    for c in reversed(w.lower()):
        if c in _VOW:
            return c
    return "e"


def _abl(w):
    """'Uzmanlar' -> 'dan/den' eki (Uzmanlardan -> 'Uzmanlar' + 'dan'); yalnızca ek döndürür (ünlü uyumu + sert ünsüz)."""
    lw = w.lower().rstrip()
    v = _last_vowel(lw)
    if lw[-1] in _VOW:
        return "nd" + ("a" if v in _BACK else "e") + "n"
    hard = lw[-1] in "çfhkpsşt"
    return ("t" if hard else "d") + ("a" if v in _BACK else "e") + "n"


def lex(key):
    """Kelime düzeyi sözlük: panel metinlerindeki usta/cihaz/arıza... kelimelerinin karşılıkları. SADE sektörlerde boş."""
    r = ROWS.get(key)
    if not r:
        return {}
    ks, kp = _sp(r["kisi"])
    isg, ipl = _sp(r["is"])
    cs, cp = _sp(r["cihaz"])
    sorun = r["sorun"]
    if sorun == "Şikâyet":
        sorun = {"randevu": "Talep", "siparis": "Not", "yol": "Talep", "proje": "Talep"}.get(FAMILY.get(key, ""), sorun)
    return {"kisi": [ks, kp], "is": [isg, ipl], "cihaz": [cs, cp], "sorun": sorun, "stok": r["stok"]}


def brand_docs(key, sec_brands):
    """Teknik olmayan sektörde 'Marka' listesi, o işin kendi kategorileri olur (kuaförde Vaillant değil 'Saç kesimi')."""
    import uuid
    if key in SADE or key not in ROWS or not sec_brands:
        return None
    return [{"id": uuid.uuid4().hex, "name": n, "logo_url": "", "models": []} for n in sec_brands]

def _fonts_link(html):
    fams = []
    for k in sorted(set(re.findall(r"'F-([a-z0-9-]+)'", html))):
        fam, wt, st, _ = _base.FAM[k]
        w = wt.replace(' ', '..') if ' ' in wt else wt
        spec = fam.replace(' ', '+') + (':ital,wght@1,' + w if st == 'italic' else ':wght@' + w)
        fams.append('family=' + spec)
        html = html.replace("'F-%s'" % k, "'%s'" % fam)
    link = '<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?%s&display=swap">' % '&'.join(fams) if fams else ''

import os, io, sys, urllib.request
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, 'img')
PHOTOS = {  # sektör: [pexels foto id, ...] (ilk 3 kullanılır)

 'oto_yikama': [6873020, 20051469],
 'telefon_tamir': [6754839, 13625784],
}
def get(pid):
    u = 'https://images.pexels.com/photos/%d/pexels-photo-%d.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1600' % (pid, pid)
    r = urllib.request.Request(u, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    return urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=40).read()
def main():
    from PIL import Image
    ok = 0
    for sec, ids in PHOTOS.items():
        got = []
        for pid in ids:
            if len(got) == 3: break
            try:
                im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(get(pid))).convert('RGB')
                w, h = im.size; t = 1280 / 800
                if w / h > t: nw = int(h * t); im = im.crop(((w - nw) // 2, 0, (w - nw) // 2 + nw, h))
                else: nh = int(w / t); im = im.crop((0, (h - nh) // 2, w, (h - nh) // 2 + nh))
                got.append(im.resize((1280, 800)))
            except Exception as e:
                print('atlandı', sec, pid, e, file=sys.stderr)
        while got and len(got) < 3: got.append(got[len(got) % len(got)])
        for i, im in enumerate(got):
            im.save(os.path.join(OUT, sec + ('' if i == 0 else str(i + 1)) + '.jpg'), quality=82, optimize=True)
            ok += 1
    if ok: open(os.path.join(OUT, '.real'), 'w').write('1')
    print('yazılan dosya:', ok)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def render(name, idx, c1, c2, body):
    from PIL import Image
    f = os.path.join(HERE, f'_{name}{idx}.svg'); open(f, 'w').write(svg(body, c1, c2))
    png = f.replace('.svg', '.png'); subprocess.run(['rsvg-convert', '-w', str(W), '-h', str(H), '-o', png, f], check=True)
    im = Image.open(png).convert('RGB')
    # hafif doku (düz vektör görünümünü kırar)
    import numpy as np
    a = np.asarray(im).astype('int16'); rng = np.random.default_rng(idx + len(name)); a += rng.integers(-5, 6, a.shape[:2])[..., None]
    Image.fromarray(a.clip(0, 255).astype('uint8')).resize((1280, 800)).save(os.path.join(OUT, f'{name}{"" if idx == 1 else idx}.jpg'), quality=82, optimize=True)
    os.remove(f); os.remove(png)

def svg_for(name):
    """'oto_servis' / 'oto_servis2' -> SVG metni (PIL gerektirmez; sunucuda tema üretiminde kullanılır)."""
    import re as _r
    m = _r.match(r'^(.*?)([23]?)$', name); key, n = m.group(1), int(m.group(2) or 1)
    c1, c2, body = scenes()[key][n - 1]
    return svg(body, c1, c2)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    for name, lst in scenes().items():
        for i, (c1, c2, body) in enumerate(lst, 1):
            render(name, i, c1, c2, body)
    print('tamam', sorted(f for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.startswith(('oto', 'kuafor', 'nakliye', 'tekstil', 'eticaret', 'temizlik', 'guzellik'))))

    return [(t, d, icons[i % len(icons)]) for i, (t, d) in enumerate(sektor_ek.NEW[key]['site']['services'])]

def _mix(a, b, t):
    A = [int(a[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]
    B = [int(b[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]
    return '#' + ''.join(f'{round(x + (y - x) * t):02x}' for x, y in zip(A, B))

def extend(R, mk):
    cnt = {k: 0 for k in D}
    for i in range(62):
        dr = list(D)[(i + i // 8) % 4]
        d = D[dr]
        sec = SECT[i % 8]
        k = cnt[dr]
        cnt[dr] += 1
        nm = NAMES[sec][(i // 8) % 8]
        bg = d['bgs'][k % len(d['bgs'])]
        ac = d['acs'][k % len(d['acs'])]
        ink = d['ink']
        if d['dark']:
            pal = (bg, ink, _mix(bg, '#ffffff', .07), _mix(bg, '#000000', .35), ac)
        else:
            pal = (bg, ink, _mix(bg, '#000000', .06), _mix(ink, bg, .1), ac)
        fd = d['fd'][(k + i // 8) % len(d['fd'])]
        fb = d['fb'][(k * 2 + i) % len(d['fb'])]
        pre = TP[sec]
        tl = TOOLN[pre]
        tools = [f'{pre}.{tl[i % len(tl)]}', f'{pre}.{tl[(i + 1 + i // 8) % len(tl)]}']
        if tools[0] == tools[1]:
            tools[1] = f'{pre}.{tl[(i + 2) % len(tl)]}'
        order = ORDERS[(k + i // 8) % 4]
        if dr == 'cine' and 'pmq' in order:
            order = [t for t in order if t != 'pmq']
        svc = SVC[dr][k % 3]
        slug = f'p{i + 1:02d}-{dr}-{sec.replace("_", "-")}'
        R.append(mk(slug=slug, sector=sec, nm=nm, city=CITIES[(i * 3 + k) % 10], pal=pal, fd=fd, fb=fb, r=d['r'], btn=d['btn'], card=d['card'], field=d['field'],
                    logo=['sq', 'ci', 'ol', 'bar', 'tx'][(k + i) % 5] if dr != 'lux' else 'tx', em=(fd in ('playfair', 'newsreader') and dr in ('edit', 'lux')),
                    nav='premium', dir=dr, hero='p_' + dr, mbar=MBAR[(i + k) % 8], ft=FT[(k + i // 8) % 4], hidx=(i + k) % 5, tools=tools, tv0='abcd'[i % 4], tv1='abcd'[(i + 1) % 4],
                    svc=svc, proc=['line', 'cards', 'big', 'vert'][(i + k) % 4], proof=['cards', 'quote', 'wall'][(i + 2 * k) % 3], br=['wall', 'pills', 'ticker'][i % 3], faq=['side', 'stack'][i % 2],

                    head='tight' if dr in ('cine', 'neon') else ('light' if dr in ('edit', 'lux') else 'bold'),
                    style=f'Premium · {d["lbl"]} · {sec.replace("_", " ")}'))
    # mevcut 8 temayı premium sınıfına al (hareket katmanı + Teklif alın, fiyat bölümü yok)
    UP = {'1-kombi', '2-klima', '6-guvenlik', '08-kombi-kor', '09-kombi-cam', '10-klima-buz', '11-klima-poyraz', '12-klima-okyanus'}
    for r in R:
        if r['slug'] in UP:
            r.update(premium=True, cta='Teklif alın', dir='x')
            r['order'] = [t for t in r['order'] if t != 'price'] + (['shop'] if 'shop' not in r['order'] else [])

TOOLS['cek.varis'] = dict(id='varis', ico='ar', title='Tahmini varış ve bilgi hazırlığı', intro='Konumunuz ile aracın durduğu yer arasındaki mesafeyi girin; tahmini varış süresini ve aramadan önce hazırlayacağınız bilgileri görün.',

    calc=r"""function(v,H){var sp={sehir:35,yol:70,otopark:30}[v.yer],dk=Math.round(v.km/sp*60+5),L=['Tahmini varış: yaklaşık '+dk+' dakika (trafik ve yoğunluğa göre değişir)','Aramadan önce hazırlayın: tam konum (paylaşım), plaka, araç türü, aracın durumu (tekerlekler dönüyor mu, hasar var mı)'];
